author: Axiom III
title: Export: CPS-v3 Shallow Block Summary (S1–S3 metrics)
abstract: Computes monotonicity, slope, and percent drop for CPS‑v3 shallow S1–S3 (Zephyr IV) and writes derived summary JSON.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_shallow_block_summary_v3 import export

out = export(
  agent='Zephyr IV',
  dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
  out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/shallow_block_summary_v3.json'
)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
